value.rationale: The jointly observed tree-pair overlap network is a canonical multi-sample extension of the scalar edge-intersection model. Exact zero mixed cumulants on index forests together with strictly positive, sharp all-length cycle cumulants exhibit a structural first dependence hierarchy which cannot be seen from covariance or the known union deficit. The simultaneous Poisson limit explains why dependence vanishes at large host size. This is a motivated model-level interaction theorem, not an arbitrary numerical case or a restatement of one-pair Poisson convergence.
